name: GOONS!
description:
About This Game

GOONS! is a roguelike autobattler where you collect tons of silly aliens and use powerful synergies to take down your foes! Play against PvE battles or against real players with asynchronous PvP! Travel across space to explore shops, battles, and special events! Build your team of Goons and empower them with synergies, trinkets, and more.

80+ Goons
20+ Items
20+ Trinkets
15+ Special Events
5 Bosses
short_desc: GOONS! is a roguelike auto-battler where you travel through space, building an army of silly little aliens! Discover powerful, game-breaking synergies to take down your foes!
